name: E. Launcher: elements left in the robot
description: After program 2 practice a NECTAR is still sitting against the front gate and a POLLEN against the back gate. Program 7 says nothing loaded: look in the launcher lanes before you start (Workbench, Intake + launchers, Empty the robot). Forget, and the recovery shot fires two elements: a bigger dip and slower recovery than one shot really gives.
